Sending company data to ChatGPT is a confidentiality concern because any data and/or code sent to the platform is likely to be used for subsequent training, which raises issues regarding the confidentiality of corporate data and intellectual property. This can lead to the disclosure and misuse of sensitive information, potentially damaging the organization's image and reputation.

In response to the incident where Samsung engineers leaked sensitive data while using ChatGPT to correct errors in their source code, Samsung banned the use of this generative AI internally and plans to develop its own AI.
